d:
The Lakers defeated the Suns, 131-123 tonight in Phoenix. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 43 points along with 9 assists and 5 three pointers for the Lakers, while Quentin Grimes tallied 22 points, 6 rebounds and 5 three pointers in the game. Collin Gillespie recorded 26 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The Lakers improve their record to 12-2 with the win, while the Suns fall to 5-7 for the season.
